scope:
Bounded controller-only transport from five clean eastern-box hands-free histories.

Only the accepted pre-entry level-select flag and controller fields are written.
Whole-state restores select native histories; no pose/action/held/cache/timer is
supplied. This finite transport search is not an Ink-route exclusion.
preEntrySetup: create_game sets gDebugLevelSelect=1 before level entry

bounds.beamMenu: Toward pyramid; velocity-relative offsets -67.5,-45,-22.5,0,22.5,45,67.5 degrees; four cardinal headings; north with B only in FREEFALL; east with Z released then held. Other entries hold Z.

beams.pruning: Preserve live stock box47 held; area1, no delayed warp, health>=0x100, valid camera. Rank distance/height/speed with 80-unit cells and speed/yaw diversity.
